items.difficulty_reason: 41 行、三步（振性检测非零对象的经典论证）：①ample ⇒ 拟紧分离 ⇒ 用 affine-diagonal proposition 把 K 写成拟凝聚层复形 F^bullet，取非零上同调层与一点；②取 L^{⊗n} 的截面 s 使 X_s 为仿射开邻域，把茎上的非零类铺开到 X_s 上的闭链 τ'（截面函子在仿射上正合）；③两次应用 invert-s-sections 引理：先提升为整体 τ''⊗s^{⊗m}，再幂次加深使 F^{p+1} 分量归零 ⇒ τ'' 给出 H^p(X, K⊗^L L^{⊗(m+l)n}) 的非零类。承重的铺开与两次提升都在 span 内；4 处引用（1 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-nonzero-some-cohomology (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4284-4292

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the representation of the object by a complex of quasi-coherent modules, the choice of a nonzero cohomology class supported at a point, the spreading of the class to an affine open of a section of a power of the ample sheaf, and the two applications of the section-inverting lemma to lift the class to a global twisted section representing a nonzero cohomology class of the twisted complex (source lines 4294-4324)
